_doc: class-absent, by-type AND scalar — must have its key here or the gate
fails. This converts the old non-gating class-absent bucket (the blind
spot that let Power of the Depths' +Range drop stay CI-green for two
months) into an enumerated, frozen exception set: a NEW whole-class drop
now fails CI and can only ship via a reviewed addition to this file,
with a reason. Keys: by-type = 'effectType|subType|sign', scalar =
Reasons distinguish 'by design' (converter documentedly drops it on
purpose) from 'known gap' (real modeling gap, tracked, not yet built).

byTypeCollapse.Mez|immobilize|: Focused Fighting — display-name aggregation across NPC variants of the power, not a player last-write-wins collapse (documented FP in the worklist scope note, 2026-07-05).

classAbsent.Mez|teleport|: Savage Leap — the Teleport attrib is the self-teleport-to-target mechanic of the leap, not a player-facing mez; by design not surfaced as a mez slot.
classAbsent.Defense|all|-: Dual Blades AoE_Bridge — combo-mode pseudopower; its -Def rides a `kDD_DebuffMode_2 Source.Mode?` gate that collectAllTemplates skips by design (mode-gated conditionals are mutually exclusive stances).
classAbsent.Mez|immobilize|: Telekinesis (Mind Control) — repel/immobilize composite edge case; known gap (control/self-conditional edge cases, worklist scope note).

discriminatorCollapse.self-penalty|Movement: Reaction Time — by design. The power's −0.7 movement templates are OnDeactivate undo-mods (they fire only when the toggle drops, reversing the OnTick +0.7 sustain buffs; confirmed vs CoD2 field-for-field). The shifted ATTRIB_MOD_APPLICATION table (fixed 2026-07-20) had mislabeled them OnActivate, so the converter's OnDeactivate skip missed them and a phantom self-penalty atom shipped; with correct labels the skip drops them, collapsing the phantom.

discriminatorClassAbsent.self-penalty|Movement: Geode — by design (data-gaps-174). Its only movement-family row is the kFly mode kill (`Fly -10000 Melee_Ones`), a flight-mode grant magnitude, not a speed; the extractor no longer folds mode-axis rows into the slow display slots (they'd render as a -1,000,000% slow). The atom stream still carries the row as subType FlyMode.
discriminatorClassAbsent.twin-unenhanced|Regeneration: Genetic Corruption (Stalker Bio Armor) — its IgnoreStrength +Regen is gated on `kRestedAdaptation Source.Mode?` (Efficient stance only) and wholly dropped from base output, exactly like its already-allowlisted Rested-stance +Res block (see classAbsent Genetic Corruption entries). Same self-conditional known gap; the real enhanceable/unenhanceable regen twins (Gamma Boost, Fast Healing, Obscure Sustenance) all correctly emit regenBuffUnenhanced and pass.

scalarClassAbsent.Range|-: Foe -Range debuff (Taunt family, ~75 powers) — dropped by design for caster-stat purposes; the converter's range branch documents it ('foe-side debuff, dropped'). Modeling foe -Range as a first-class debuff is a possible future restoration.
scalarClassAbsent.MaxHP|-: Brine — foe -MaxHP; by design not surfaced (extractEffects: 'Target -MaxHP isn't currently modeled on the build side').
scalarClassAbsent.ToHit|-: Dual Blades AoE_Bridge — mode-gated (`kDD_DebuffMode_2 Source.Mode?`) -ToHit; collector's mode-skip drops it by design.
scalarClassAbsent.ToHit|+: Wind Control Clear Skies — stance-mode-gated (`kClearSkies Source.Mode?`) self buffs; collector's mode-skip drops them; stance system owns this content. Known gap if the stance system doesn't surface it.
scalarClassAbsent.Recovery|+: Wind Control Clear Skies — same stance-mode gate as its ToHit|+.
scalarClassAbsent.Regeneration|+: Genetic Corruption — self-conditional edge case; known gap.
